gloss: food and drink; food and beverage products

definitions.gloss: food and drink; food and beverage products
definitions.explanation: A collective term for items that are consumed as food or drink. Used in commercial, regulatory, and everyday contexts to refer to edible and drinkable goods.

examples.japanese: {飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Bringing in food and drink is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This store mainly deals in food and beverage products.

examples.japanese: {飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全体的|ぜんたいてき}→全体的：11663_zentaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Prices of food and drink products are rising overall.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧ (eating and drinking) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods; products). Commonly seen on signs, in regulations, and in business contexts. The related term ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧ refers to the act of eating and drinking, while {飲食品|いんしょくひん} specifically refers to the products themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧: bringing in food and drink
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sale of food and beverages
- {飲食品|いんしょくひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: food and beverage section

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧: eating and drinking — the activity rather than the products
- ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧: restaurant; eatery — an establishment serving food and drink
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food products — excludes beverages
- ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧: beverages; drinks — covers only the drink side
